name: spn-surface
description: SaaS Plane surface domain, stack-agnostic — what a person sees and touches, stated before any stack is chosen: the standards of content, interaction, patterns and names, the architecture of the design system, its library and its delivery, and the app, site and flow patterns a page starts from. Its skill is design, which states a page, a flow or a mock as a tree of named blocks and draws it in Figma where the window holds the connector. A ref reaches a session only when something names it.
